headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and rising — 42.7/100; Lombok Strait is the lead driver, -31% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **42.7/100** (**high**), up 0.6 pts week-over-week. 4 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Lombok Strait**, running **29.0/day** vs a normal of **42.0/day** (-31%).
**396** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Strait of Hormuz** is running **85% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$88.9/bbl** (-8.3% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$149.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$580K** cost-of-delay ($331K–$917K).
